questions: Was valuables insurance claimed for any affected item? If so, which item?
Did anyone suffer bodily injury in connection with the event?
Is there another insurance covering the same items, risks and period?
Did the contractor cause or increase the loss through fault, or has CSS paid benefits supporting a claim against the contractor?
Is an assignment of the insurance benefit to a third party being sought or asserted?
Have the parties selected a jointly appointed expert or formal expert proceedings? Have experts made findings?
Were crime-scene traces or damaged items altered, and if so, was consent obtained or was the change otherwise justified?
Were loss-mitigation instructions issued, and were they followed, or was there imminent danger?
When did you become aware of the loss and insurance claim, and when was the insurer notified?
Was an official police investigation requested, and what is its status? What other traces, witnesses or circumstances support the loss?
